theorem lg_target {E : Type u_1} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] {f : UpperHalfPlane → E} (hf_cont : Continuous f) (hf_infinity : UpperHalfPlane.IsBoundedAtImInfty f) (hf_inv : ∀ (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (τ : UpperHalfPlane), f (g • τ) = f τ) : ∃ C, ∀ (τ : UpperHalfPlane), ‖f τ‖ ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨M, A⟩ := UpperHalfPlane.IsBoundedAtImInfty.bounded_at_im_infty hf_infinity
  use M
  intro τ
  exact le_trans (‖f τ‖) M
